visualBrief: Three pale steel tied arches over twin electrified tracks, flanked by two three-lane road decks. Concrete approach piers, diagonal hangers, cross ties, catenary and rail hardware are authored at the appropriate levels.
observations: The new crossing places two road carriageways outside two rail tracks. Three pale tied arch spans with solid box ribs and diagonal hangers straddle the rail corridor.
The adjacent older rail crossing is about 39 m north of the new alignment. Its lighter lattice arch trusses remain native.
limitations: The rail and road axes follow Protomaps PMTiles. The four arch feet were picked in the aerial view, with approximately 3 m plan uncertainty.
Deck grades, arch rises, individual pier stations and small fittings are reconstructed from exterior photos and standard Terrarium terrain.
The adjoining old railway crossing and connecting ramps remain native to the viewer.
